review_method: Read each linked page, compared its concepts with existing notes and the revised local AQA specification. Retained existing worked examples, tables and diagrams. Additions use original wording and examples.
sections_refined: Inputs, processing, outputs and trace tables

coverage_decisions.decision: Existing decomposition, abstraction, inputs/process/output, representations and efficiency were already developed. Added a selective-output trace and the effects of moving initialisation/output.
Retained correct current binary-search implementation. Added last-candidate and empty-list reasoning. Did not import source bounds that can miss the last item or unsafe REPEAT linear search.
Existing passes, flags, comparisons and illustrated merges retained. Added an odd-length merge example; equal-sized input is not a requirement.
Did not import advice to prefer pseudocode regardless of the question. Current AQA explicitly requires the requested response form.

checks.browser_review: Passed all topic reading groups and expanded deck at 1366, 390 and 320 pixels. Checked print visibility, hidden sources, focus, keyboard controls, long prose and code answers.
